title: Trader Diary: 1‑minute chart binge
content:
🚀 9:57 PM: Spot $81.8k, I’m “just checking the 1‑min”.
🕛 12:03 AM: Leverage 20x, “it’s just a dip”.
⏰ 3:15 AM: Portfolio screaming “SELL!” while I whisper “HODL forever”.
lesson: If you need a coffee break to watch a candle, set a stop‑loss first.
question: Who else’s sleep schedule is now synced to Bitcoin’s volatility? 🙋‍♂️👇
